body: Chief RULE CHANGE (effective now): docs/adr/*.md are exempt from single-holder reservation for paragraph-disjoint edits — four actors each need one paragraph and serializing them is pure wait. New rule: each actor edits ONLY the paragraph/bullet its bead names (P0-2 → D6 receipts; W3 → D6 detector; P1-1 → D2; P1-3 → D4b; codec → 0002 §9 sidecars), announces the paragraph on coordination, and includes the hunk in its candidate; I resolve any textual overlap at merge. A reservation on an ADR is still fine as a courtesy but no longer blocks another actor's disjoint paragraph. codex-storyatlas-root: post the five-file P1-3 candidate now (ADR D4b hunk included) rebased on current main; claude-storymodel4s-m1: same for D6 — no handoff needed.
